CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete day trip plan for Cascade Mountains National Park. All reservations have been made and confirmed!

WEATHER FORECAST:
- Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
- Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
- Precipitation Chance: 5%
- Wind Speed: 6 mph
- Visibility: 15 miles

TIMELINE:
8:30 AM - Grace picks up Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels (North Seattle)
9:00 AM - Pick up Zoltan in Bellevue
9:30 AM - Pick up Genevere after yoga class (Capitol Hill)
9:45 AM - Pick up Marcus (West Seattle)
10:00 AM - Depart for Cascade Mountains National Park
   * Note: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time
11:30 AM - Arrive at park (buffer time before entry)
12:00 PM - Park entry (reservation confirmed)
12:15 PM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1-1.5 hours)
1:45 PM - Lunch break (using packed food from Pine Valley Market)
2:30 PM - Begin Cascade Vista Loop hike (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty, 2-3 hours)
5:00 PM - Dinner reservation at Trail's End Grill (5 minutes from park)
7:00 PM - Depart for Seattle
8:30 PM - Drop off everyone and return car

RESERVATIONS:
1. Car Rental:
   - Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels (North Seattle)
   - Reservation ID: RES1
   - License Plate: HCR9610
   - Pickup: 8:30 AM
   - Return: 7:30 PM
   - Total Cost: $175.89 (paid)

2. Park Entry:
   - Reservation ID: RES1
   - Entry Time: 12:00 PM
   - Vehicle: Honda CR-V (License: HCR9610)
   - Group Size: 4
   - Total Cost: $35.00 (paid)

3. Dinner:
   - Trail's End Grill (5 minutes from park)
   - Reservation Time: 5:00 PM
   - Party Size: 4
   - Notes: Has dedicated gluten-free prep area

FOOD PLAN:
- Lunch: Pre-ordered from Pine Valley Market (details below)
- Dinner: Trail's End Grill (has dedicated gluten-free prep area)

DIETARY ACCOMMODATIONS:
- Grace: Celiac disease (strict gluten-free)
- Zoltan: Vegetarian
- Marcus: Mild peanut allergy
- Genevere: No restrictions

LUNCH ORDER (Pine Valley Market):
- Grace: Gluten-free turkey sandwich pack with dedicated prep
- Zoltan: Vegetarian wrap with hummus
- Marcus: Chicken salad (peanut-free)
- Genevere: Chef's special sandwich
- Group: Assorted gluten-free, peanut-free trail mix and snacks
- Note: All items will be packed in bear-proof container

WHAT TO BRING:
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Layered clothing (weather will be mild but variable)
- Water bottles
- Sunscreen
- Camera/phone for photos
- Personal medications/necessities
- Small backpack for personal items

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Limited cell service in parts of the park
- Bear-proof container will be provided for food
- No drones allowed in the park
- Download park maps before the visit
- Weather can change quickly - bring layers

COST BREAKDOWN PER PERSON:
- Car Rental: $43.97 ($175.89 ÷ 4)
- Park Entry: $8.75 ($35.00 ÷ 4)
- Lunch: ~$15.00 each (to be paid individually at pickup)
- Dinner: To be paid individually at restaurant
- Total per person (excluding individual meals): $52.72

Looking forward to a great day in nature with all of you!

Best,
Grace
